Binary SHA-256: `820b9c10aa8d8a422d464bcf920e15aef0315a865902c6798e64673f8225a985`.

```text
ELF 64-bit LSB pie executable, x86-64, version 1 (SYSV), dynamically linked, interpreter /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, BuildID[sha1]=4d87e5339520defc6fa0bac04a4f69a2e9474779, for GNU/Linux 3.2.0, not stripped
```

Source correspondence findings:

STT_FILE cpp_classes.cpp, demangled A/B/C methods, RTTI and vtable symbols agree with the source. ELF main is 0x129d (Ghidra default 0x10129d). Direct C::bar call is 0x134b; computed calls are 0x1361, 0x1378 and 0x138f. Thunk at 0x14cb subtracts 8 from RDI then jumps to C::tool at 0x1490. C::C sets k at offset 0x10 to zero.

Compiler markers are object-level hints, not proof of complete build flags:

GCC: (Ubuntu 9.3.0-17ubuntu1~20.04) 9.3.0
